limits: Full file MD5/CRC and exact GRCh38 nonpalindromic lead matches required. Source-derived SE only. Same GWAS as Open Targets, not independent validation or LD-pruned MR. No estimate of missing SE from rounded P-values.

Open Targets postprocessed fine-mapping of the same original Korean GWAS (Lee et al 2022), not independent replication or full original summary statistics. Lead effects may be missing; no new colocalization, instrument selection, MR or merging distinct wrinkle phenotypes. Check ancestry and LD source before mechanistic use.
